name: PhenoInfra
atlas: Recover runtime/provisioner, manifest, secrets, state, backup/restore and consumer contracts. Separate reusable libraries from environment-specific resources.
reuse: Use supported provider/runtime APIs, existing reconciliation tools and verified backup software. Do not establish a new cluster to satisfy a GitOps label.
acceptance: A real clean consumer provisions and recovers its intended resource, and a restore drill preserves state and ownership.

name: PhenoTooling
role: Quality, developer workflow and absorbed tool capabilities
atlas: Inventory all languages and nested workspaces, advertised commands, native tools, copied products and false-green scaffolds. Every verifier must prove a negative case.
reuse: Adopt maintained checkers/indexers/test frameworks and normalize receipts; avoid weaker in-house clones.
acceptance: Real checkers reject seeded failures; product copies have one writer/release authority; actual consumers install and use the supported package.

name: PhenoAI
atlas: Identify embeddings, providers, agent SDK, device drivers and artifact contracts independently. Resolve which consumers require each package and distinguish Agentora from similarly named CLI frameworks.
reuse: Prefer established SDKs, framework adapters and provider clients; maintain narrow owned policy and unsupported capability deltas.
acceptance: Each retained package has a clean consumer, truthful support profile and an adopt/patch/wrap/retain decision backed by tests.

name: PhenoGfx
atlas: Map data ownership, renderer adapters, native ABI, asset conversion and required game consumers. A byte-compatible API and a semantically correct rendering path are different proofs.
reuse: Reuse engine facilities and common data formats; minimize cross-engine wrappers to the actual shared contract.
acceptance: At least the accepted real consumers exercise the canonical package with correct ABI/data/rendering and explicit performance budgets.

name: PhenoRegistry
role: Curated portfolio identity and ownership projection
atlas: Use immutable repo IDs and explicit accepted lifecycle/role records. Separate GitHub facts from proposed disposition and externally owned work/evidence state.
reuse: Adapt small declarative catalogs or Backstage concepts; no new universal database.
acceptance: The live roster resolves aliases, names current allowed actions and links truthful evidence without overriding source owners.

name: PhenoDesign
role: Shared visual identity, tokens, components and creative-source custody
atlas: Locate editable source, export recipes, actual consumers and accepted brand scope. Do not regenerate a brand because a legacy README says archived.
reuse: Use established design-token formats, accessible UI libraries, Blender/Adobe and appropriate exporters.
acceptance: Real consumers use consistent tokens/assets; visual, accessibility, performance and rights checks pass; source edits reproducibly produce deliverable variants.

name: KooshaPari
atlas: Map each public claim to an actual product/release, active URL, docs version and artifact. Preserve private/public boundaries and honest installation status.
reuse: Reuse the existing landing/PhenoDocs composition and platform deployment facilities rather than build another registry.
acceptance: An unfamiliar visitor can understand the portfolio, find working product/docs/install paths and distinguish measured capability from plans.

name: PhenoApps
atlas: Resolve the actual FocalPoint application source, Localbase and RIPFitnessApp future disposition separately. A shared repository must not force a shared product, database or release lifecycle.
reuse: Use package/workspace boundaries, native application frameworks and mature domain facilities.
acceptance: Each accepted app remains independently installable, testable and understandable; no archive or donor deletion follows from this dossier.

name: Agentora-capability
atlas: Inventory the actual exported Rust/other framework, tools, state, model adapters, storage and consumers. Locate legacy Agentora code by lineage rather than an agentkit string alone.
reuse: Compare direct SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, CrewAI, Mastra, PydanticAI and Rig; prefer a maintained foundation where it preserves the valuable contract.
acceptance: A matched coding-agent pilot proves correctness, ergonomics and recovery; retained custom behavior has a defensible measured benefit or internal boundary.
